about_the_game:
Dive into this fast-paced precision platformer 2D. Jump, dodge, and teleport to survive in an environment that will do everything it can to stop you. Overcome the challenges to unravel the mysterious plot. Are you ready to never stop running?

FEATURES

  • Single-player 2D adventure where you’ll discover a unique and fast-paced world while uncovering the mysteries behind the plot of this thrilling precision platformer.

  • Progressive increase in difficulty and speed: As you advance, your speed gradually increases, forcing you to be more precise with every move and making things more challenging step by step.

  • Gradual world deterioration: With each step you take, the environment becomes increasingly dangerous and hostile.

  • Color tones that shift throughout the level.

DEMO CONTENT

  • Includes a compact test level that brings together the main mechanics of the game.

  • The art in this demo is not final and may change in the future.

  • Not all mechanics are included.

  • The game’s story is not included in this demo.

WARNING

This is just a small glimpse of what the final game will be! There’s still a lot of work ahead, but if you enjoyed it and want to know more, we invite you to follow us on social media at @cantstoprunning.game.
We’d also love to hear what you think—leave us a comment on Steam or message us directly on Instagram.

See you when the full game is ready!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended
